rows.title: Increases in Kratom-Related Reports to Poison Centers - National Poison Data System, United States, 2015-2025.
rows.journal: MMWR. Morbidity and mortality weekly report
rows.focus: National Poison Data System analysis found kratom-related poison-center reports rose sharply from 2015 to 2025. Multiple-substance reports had higher hospitalization and serious-outcome rates and accounted for most kratom-associated deaths in the dataset.
rows.evidence_boundary: Poison-center surveillance is descriptive and subject to reporting bias; it identifies trends and risk patterns rather than population incidence or causality.

rows.title: Buprenorphine for the Management of 7-Hydroxymitragynine (7-OH) Use: A Retrospective Case Series.
rows.focus: Retrospective case series of nine patients with problematic purified 7-OH use described buprenorphine initiation strategies; most patients were successfully initiated and reported symptom improvement, without precipitated withdrawal in the reported series.
rows.evidence_boundary: Small retrospective uncontrolled case series; useful for emerging clinical management signals but insufficient to establish comparative efficacy, optimal dosing, or generalizable protocols.
